W-S1 complete against input revision `a32558a419404dfe741182b6713ce1f31062fd37`. Source frozen; ownership released.

Implemented only:

- `tools/muon_layout/wheels_acts/analyze.py`
- `tools/muon_layout/wheels_acts/draw.py`
- `tools/muon_layout/wheels_acts/compare.py`

CLIs:

```sh
python analyze.py --work WORK --run RUN --output OUTPUT
python draw.py OUTPUT FIGURE_DIR
python compare.py --before BEFORE_OUTPUT --after AFTER_OUTPUT --output COMPARISON_DIR
```

Outputs retain raw event IDs/positions/statuses, full and fixed-endcap denominators, endcap-only and mixed-family counters, individual wheel availability, unresolved-event bounds, paired changes, sampling errors, contingencies and source/input hashes.

Passed: 11 existing counter tests; CLI/syntax checks; focused paired-bound and stratified-error checks; synthetic 480-row CSV/NPZ roundtrip; adverse metadata rejection; comparison plus ten rendered figures. Three figure types visually checked. Plot runtime: installed ACTS Python, NumPy 2.5.4, Matplotlib 3.11.2.

Real native scan validation remains root-owned. Synthetic fixtures provide software checks only.

limitations: Only userMessage and agentMessage text retained; reasoning, tool arguments/results and private state excluded.
Conservative path, credential, email and URL redaction is not a privacy guarantee; review retained text.
Exposed operation counts are per retained turn; journal counts can describe the same invocations and must not be added.
